entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is ridiculous. Get me a person! Agent!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this VeloBand. Your company's return process is a complete joke and I am absolutely furious.

I'm very sorry to hear about your frustrating experience. I can certainly look into this for you. So I can understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device or a matter of preference?
It's a preference! I don't like it and I want my money back. I've been trying to do this for weeks but your website is a train wreck.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your order number to pull up your account?
VF98112. And don't waste my time.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered on December 15th. That puts you at 25 days ago.
Don't you dare try to use that against me! I tried to return it on December 24th, NINE days after I got it! Your whole system was down! It was a massive website error, and I have proof!
I see. So you're saying you attempted the return online, but a system issue prevented it?

YES! That's what I'm saying! The site crashed every time I tried to start the return. I couldn't print the label, I couldn't do anything! I even took a screenshot of the error page. This is VeloFit's fault, not mine. Get me your manager right now; I am not getting ripped off.
There's no need to speak with a manager, sir. I can handle this for you. Let me just quickly check our official return policy for your item... One moment.
This is unbelievable. I'm already writing a one-star review.
Okay, I've pulled up the policy here. And I do want to apologize. It looks like you're well within the return period. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Ninety days? Then why was this so difficult?

It shouldn't have been, and I sincerely apologize for the trouble the website error caused you. I can also confirm that we did experience a known system down event on that date. Since you're only on day 25, I can process this return for a full refund immediately. No problem at all.
Oh. Well... fine. About time someone did their job. Yes, process it.

Certainly. I have just authorized the return in our system. I am sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the original box and drop it at any post office. You'll receive your refund 3-5 business days after we receive the item.
Alright. See that it gets done.
It will be taken care of. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. That's it.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
